verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents showing Buildkite builds as checks on pull requests and on a CI tab. GitHub Actions results also arrive as checks for repositories synced with GitHub. Those checks then feed ruleset requirements and stack check states. However, support is evidenced only for these two named integrations, and only at the pull-request level. missing for 10: a documented generic commit-status/checks API that any external CI service can report to, explicit display of checks on individual commits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see builds from external CI services reported as status checks on commits and pull requests
